summary: Process private rent payments and generate verifiable receipts.
description_long: Privora allows tenants to pay rent privately on Starknet and generates a verifiable payment receipt for landlords. The project consists of a Rust-based backend, a React + TypeScript web client, and PostgreSQL migrations for data storage. It implements a privacy receipt model and verifies transactions against the Starknet Mainnet, ensuring no private keys are stored in the repository.
